decisions: The new quote.amendment.create operation/receipt uses schema3 to bind immutable parent agreement ID, version and accepted content hash. Existing schema1/2 operation preimages and quote-content v1/v2 remain unchanged.

Recovery references contain only original IDs and versions. Accepted/proposed hashes/content, prices, contacts, observations and credentials are not persisted by this new reference boundary. A live request also pins its parent hash; recovery relies on the independently verified immutable SQL result.

The existing closed quote command role gains INSERT only on kind/parent columns, never browser/worker access or parent UPDATE. Draft editing and owner review reuse existing commands under family lock/current-parent checks.
An enabled deferred guard verifies the schema3 original result against exact audited rows; no caller can substitute a fabricated committed receipt.
Unaccepted Draft/edit/review/owner approval changes no accepted agreement, entitlement, allocation or financial effect. Customer acceptance is separate and unfinished.
verified: Actual initial lifecycle and original accepted projection/obligations remain intact.
Parent-bound creation, original lookup and exact replay, including replay after later editing.
Changed-body/parent replay refusal, stale parent/version/hash/family refusal with rolled-back operation claims.
Draft edits, distinct submit/approval and exact typed app receipt consumer.
Competing creates serialize on existing family locks with one commit and one version conflict.
A saved line cannot silently move vehicles in create or edit; explicit new identity is allowed while accepted scope stays unchanged.
Foreign authenticated principal denied; private helpers and parent updates stay closed to browser/worker.
Unexpected default function grants refuse installation before new surface creation.
Deferred fabricated-receipt attempt fails; owned test rows/clusters cleaned without disabling RLS/triggers.
retainedFailures: First draft run29/36: explicit kind/parent INSERT needed on the existing column-restricted closed quote role. Added only those two columns; dependent cases then pass.
Second36/37: the SET CONSTRAINTS test omitted the private schema qualification. Corrected the fixture, retaining the actual deferred guard/assertion.
Third39/39 passed. Fourth consumer run23/24: plain Node caught extensionless TypeScript imports accepted by the unit bundler. Added explicit .ts imports.

Final40/40 includes real typed receipt consumption and default-grant refusal. Initial script source replacement treated a SQL regex dollar quote as a JS replacement token; preparation assertion caught it before output/execution and literal replacement fixed it.
remaining: Manual sharing, separate customer acceptance, coherent full resulting agreement and entitlement/remaining-allocation versions, atomic completed/billed/credited/refunded limits.
Current version2+ agreement transitions, converted-lead parents and full cancellation/empty resulting-scope semantics must be verified before adoption; do not invent a complimentary placeholder.
Versioned amendment-aware saved readers/history/UI/controller and interrupted-original retirement/reference integration.
